results.title: First Phase of Jinnah Medical Complex to Be Completed by March 2027
results.description: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has directed the authorities to complete the first phase of the Jinnah Medical Complex and Research Centre by March 2027 to provide modern healthcare services to citizens as early as possible.
